title: Package Discovery and Information
key_relationships: SearchCommand depends_on CompositeRepository (wraps all repos for search)
PackageInterface returned by all repository findPackages/loadPackages calls
interaction_flow: ShowCommand → RepositoryManager: getRepositories() → list of ComposerRepository
ShowCommand → CompositeRepository: wraps installed + remote repos
ShowCommand → InstalledRepository: getPackages() for installed listing
ShowCommand → CompositeRepository: getPackage(name, version) for single package lookup
ShowCommand → PackageInterface: getName(), getVersion(), getDescription(), getRequires() for display
ShowCommand → printPackageInfo / printPackageInfoAsJson: renders result to output
ComposerRepository → httpDownloader: GET searchUrl?q=query (fulltext via Packagist API)
ComposerRepository → getVendorNames(): regex grep for vendor search mode
ComposerRepository → listUrl: fetch packageNames for prefix search
ComposerRepository returns results[] to CompositeRepository → SearchCommand → Developer
important_notes: ShowCommand aliased as 'info'. ComposerRepository.search() calls Packagist HTTP API for fulltext; uses listUrl for prefix/vendor search. ArrayRepository.loadPackages() filters by constraint+stability. InstalledRepository wraps local ArrayRepository. RepositorySet used for version resolution in latest/outdated checks.
